english.title: Construct / alter / maintain dam / structure without first notifying the appropriate agency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[constructed a new dam at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(B)_[made an alteration to an existing dam at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) that was likely to affect the passage of eels around, over or through the dam]_
(C)_[maintained an existing dam at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) that was likely to affect the passage of eels around, over or through the dam]_
(D)_[constructed a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY STRUCTURE..), in or near waters at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) that amounted to, or was likely to amount to, an obstruction]_
(E)_[maintained a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY STRUCTURE..), in or near waters at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) that amounted to, or was likely to amount to, an obstruction]_

without first notifying **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), the appropriate agency
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(2), (4) and 28(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a person who constructed / altered or maintained
a dam / structure
failed to first notify the Environment Agency.
